# aikido_repository (Data Source)

Looks up exactly one Aikido code repository by name and, optionally, branch. It is an error when no repository matches or when several repositories match. Set branch when the same repository is configured for multiple branches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a repository by name instead of its numeric Aikido ID.
data "aikido_repository" "payments" {
  name = "payments"
}

resource "aikido_repository" "payments" {
  id     = data.aikido_repository.payments.id
  active = true
}

# id is a string to match aikido_repository; tonumber feeds the numeric
# code_repo_id and repo_ids attributes of the other resources.
resource "aikido_repo_pr_checks_settings" "payments" {
  code_repo_id = tonumber(data.aikido_repository.payments.id)

  minimum_severity                  = "high"
  fail_on_dependency_scan           = true
  fail_on_sast_scan                 = true
  fail_on_iac_scan                  = true
  fail_on_secrets_scan              = true
  fail_on_malware_scan              = true
  post_inline_comments_min_severity = "critical"

  minimum_license_severity = "high"

  fail_on_code_quality_scan                      = true
  enable_code_quality_scan                       = true
  post_code_quality_inline_comments_min_severity = "medium"

  run_deep_audit_pr_scan = true
}

# Set branch when several repositories have the same name.
data "aikido_repository" "checkout_develop" {
  name   = "checkout"
  branch = "develop"
}

resource "aikido_repository" "checkout_develop" {
  id     = data.aikido_repository.checkout_develop.id
  active = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the code repository, matched exactly. Matching is exact, not a substring or glob. The name and optional branch must identify exactly one repository, active or inactive.

### Optional

- `branch` (String) Branch configured for scanning. Set this to select one repository when several repositories have the same name.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the repository is activated for scanning in Aikido.
- `connectivity` (String) Whether the code runs on an internet-connected server. One of: connected, not_connected, unknown.
- `external_repo_id` (String) Repository ID from the Git provider.
- `external_repo_numeric_id` (Number) Numeric repository ID from the Git provider.
- `git_provider` (String) Git provider hosting the repository.
- `id` (String) Aikido code repository ID, as a string to match the id attribute of aikido_repository. Use tonumber(...) to feed the numeric code_repo_id and repo_ids attributes of the other resources.
- `labels` (List of String) Label names on the repository, sorted alphabetically.
- `last_scanned_at` (Number) Unix timestamp of the last completed scan, or -1 if the repository has never been scanned.
- `sensitivity` (String) Sensitivity level of the repository. One of: extreme, sensitive, normal, not_sensitive, no_data.
- `url` (String) External URL of the repository.
